limitations: This dataset is a session-curated relational raw CSV for existing read-source. It combines named original institutions; the GitHub issue origin identifies the curation, not one original measurement source or an industry16 table.

record_type=context/fact and context_id are local to each shard. For each fact, copy exactly the columns named by the matching context_fields JSON list, including empty strings. All other columns come from the fact row. Every required context is present in the same CSV; no external join is required.

preserved_qualification_sample_json preserves the prior qualification object exactly, not a claim that the publisher used this JSON schema. verified_qualifiers_json and qualification_errata_json identify verified scope and any correction without rewriting the frozen input.

original_body_sha256/bytes/acquired_at are populated only for genuinely acquired and offline-reverified source bodies. web_original_only rows leave all three empty; session_evidence_file_sha256 hashes a local research qualification, never the website body. Search-service reference IDs identify earlier evidence and do not create current HTTP receipts.

These are bounded attributed facts for source evaluation/review. Rights and limits remain source-specific. No original complete report, subscription table, restricted private sample, invented prior observation, price midpoint, VAT, physical denominator or continuous feed entitlement is supplied.

Ranges, percentages, index levels, survey denominators, flows, stocks, forecasts and policy text remain distinct. The numeric spelling and original period are preserved; overlapping datasets or regions are not additive independent upstreams.

SourceInput custody=excerpt refers to this original factual curation. Local preparation and CSV/schema roundtrip do not attest GitHub custody or native execution; the root writer verifies those separately.
